companyDescription: Former Alzheimer's biotech · sabirnetug (ACU193) failed Phase 2 ALTITUDE-AD on Oct 30, 2026 and was discontinued; now a cash shell (~$78.6M cash at Sep 30) evaluating strategic alternatives
priceNote: Live $0.2319 (-0.9%) on Nov 4, 2026 — down ~89% from $2.09 at the Oct 26 report after the Oct 30 ALTITUDE-AD failure (52-week $0.20-$3.60); 52-week range $0.20-$3.60. Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Oct 26, 2026): the binary resolved negatively. ALTITUDE-AD missed its primary endpoint at both doses (and CDR-SB), sabirnetug — the only clinical asset — was discontinued, and BofA (PT $1) and Stifel downgraded. What remains is a cash-shell setup: ~$78.6M cash at Sep 30 vs a ~$17M market cap, with management 'evaluating strategic options' (reverse merger, wind-down, or EBD program). This is no longer a moonshot thesis; it is a liquidation-value bet whose outcome depends on wind-down costs and how management deploys the cash. Base cut from +45% to +30% (above the lane's realized 30d P75 (+12.2%; written-Base bias +72.7pp)), assuming a cash-return or reverse-merger announcement within ~3-6 months. แนะนำ 0.5% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50%+.

risks: The thesis is broken: ALTITUDE-AD failed on Oct 30, 2026 and sabirnetug was discontinued. This is now a cash-shell / liquidation-value bet, not a clinical moonshot.
Cash can be consumed before it reaches shareholders: wind-down costs, severance, lease obligations and any EBD spending reduce what a liquidation or reverse merger returns.
Reverse-merger risk: shell biotechs often merge into a private company at terms that dilute existing holders heavily.
Sub-$1 price: Nasdaq continued-listing notice / reverse split risk.
Thin liquidity after an ~89% collapse — exits can be costly.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 (10–2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented for a hike). Futures price ~85% odds of another +25bp at the Dec 9 FOMC after Logan and Musalem called for more tightening; Warsh gave no explicit December signal.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Sep PCE: headline 3.6% y/y (+0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (+0.3% m/m); Q3 GDP +3.4% annualized. Oct CPI on Nov 10 is the next test — core ≥0.4% m/m would effectively lock in the December hike.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: A sub-$200M, pre-revenue biotech with under 12 months of cash is maximally exposed to financing conditions. A hawkish surprise compresses the window to raise on good data and deepens the discount on any raise after bad data.
macroRisk.summary: LOW relevance — the outcome is a corporate-action question (cash return vs reverse merger), not a macro one.

postWin.note: Average of two real Alzheimer's small-cap positive-data moves: Cassava (SAVA) +145% over Feb 2021 on simufilam cognition data, and Cognition Therapeutics (CGTX) +20.8% day-1 on its Jul 2025 Phase 2. The SAVA case was later tainted by data-integrity allegations, so treat it as the sentiment ceiling, not a base rate.

postLose.note: Athira (ATHA): LIFT-AD Alzheimer's failure on Sep 3, 2024 — -72% after hours, -81% over three sessions. This is the realistic gap-down template for a failed AD readout at a sub-$200M cap.

spotSizing.reason: 0.5%. the phase3_readout catalyst already resolved negatively; this is a cash-shell option, not a turbo thesis — token size only.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo overall medianMAE (bucket n<5) (-24.1%). A break below the tight stop before the catalyst means the market expects a dilutive reverse merger.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If ALTITUDE-AD misses the primary endpoint, exit on day 1 — do not wait for a 'subgroup' story (the Athira pattern).

comparableCases.event: Simufilam Alzheimer's cognition data + end-of-Phase-2 FDA meeting
comparableCases.note: Upside template: a sub-$200M Alzheimer's name re-rated 2.5x in one month on positive cognition data. Caveat: Cassava's data later faced integrity allegations — the move shows what sentiment does, not what the science was worth.

Downside template: Alzheimer's readout miss at a small cap. -72% after hours, -81% over three days. ABOS's bear case (-65%) assumes cash/share (~$1.09) provides only a partial floor because of ongoing burn.
Middle case: encouraging but not decisive Phase 2 data gave only +20.8% day-1. A 'directional but not 30%' ALTITUDE-AD result likely lands here.

th.summary: REFRESH (รายงานก่อน Oct 26, 2026): binary จบในทางลบ ALTITUDE-AD พลาด endpoint หลักทั้งสองขนาดยา (และ CDR-SB) sabirnetug ซึ่งเป็นสินทรัพย์ทางคลินิกตัวเดียวถูกยุติ BofA (เป้า $1) และ Stifel ลดอันดับ ที่เหลือคือ setup แบบ cash shell: เงินสด ~$78.6M ณ 30 ก.ย. เทียบ market cap ~$17M ผู้บริหาร 'ประเมินทางเลือกเชิงกลยุทธ์' (reverse merger ปิดกิจการ หรือโปรแกรม EBD) นี่ไม่ใช่ thesis แบบ moonshot แล้ว แต่เป็นการเดิมพันมูลค่าชำระบัญชีที่ขึ้นกับต้นทุนปิดกิจการและการใช้เงินสดของผู้บริหาร Base ลดจาก +45% เป็น +30% (สูงกว่า P75 30 วันจริงของกลุ่ม (+12.2%; bias +72.7pp)) สมมติประกาศคืนเงินสดหรือ reverse merger ใน ~3-6 เดือน แนะนำ 0.5% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50%+
